extras: Future roadmap includes semantic suggestions using local embeddings (Ollama or OpenAI-compatible endpoints).
motivation: To bring unlinked mentions into the editor itself, making them easily accessible while writing.
problem: Existing unlinked mentions in Obsidian are confined to the backlinks sidebar, requiring users to manually search for them.
summary: An Obsidian plugin that underlines plain-text mentions of existing notes in the editor and allows users to convert them into wiki links by clicking.
